sources.snippet: Gemma is a family of open models built by Google DeepMind. Gemma 4 models are multimodal, handling text and image input (with audio supported on small models) and generating text output. Gemma 4 introduces key capability and architectural advancements: Reasoning - All models in the family are designed as highly capable reasoners, with configurable thinking modes.
